refrain.text: There's more than two levels of hell.
refrain.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious"><prosody rate="-22%">There's more than two levels of hell.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

few.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Quite a few more.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l1a.text: The coffee is always a little too cold.
l1a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">The coffee is always a little too cold.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l1b.text: Not enough to send it back.
l1b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Not enough to send it back.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l2a.text: Every conversation begins [250ms] with someone telling you something [250ms] you already know.
l2a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Every conversation begins <break time="250ms"/> with someone telling you something <break time="250ms"/> you already know.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

words.text: begins  with someone telling you something  you already know.

under.text: People tend to underestimate the number.
under.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">People tend to underestimate the number.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

listed.text: I haven't listed all of them.
listed.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">I haven't listed all of them.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l3a.text: You are always waiting for someone.
l3a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You are always waiting for someone.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l3b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">They are never particularly late.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l3c.text: And they always have a good reason.
l3c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">And they always have a good reason.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l4b.text: The person who approves it [200ms] needs someone else's approval.
l4b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">The person who approves it <break time="200ms"/> needs someone else's approval.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l4c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Nobody knows who that is.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l5a.text: You spend your days correcting mistakes [200ms] that will be made again tomorrow.
l5a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You spend your days correcting mistakes <break time="200ms"/> that will be made again tomorrow.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

words.text: mistakes  that will be made again tomorrow.

l5b.text: The people making them [250ms] are very nice.
l5b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">The people making them <break time="250ms"/> are very nice.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l6a.text: Every decision is yours to make.
l6a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Every decision is yours to make.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l6b.text: But you aren't allowed to change anything.
l6b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">But you aren't allowed to change anything.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l7a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Everything you say is understood.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l7b.text: Nothing you say makes a difference.
l7b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Nothing you say makes a difference.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l8a.text: You are surrounded by people [200ms] who have known you for years.
l8a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You are surrounded by people <break time="200ms"/> who have known you for years.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

words.text: people  who have known you for years.

l8b.text: They all have a slightly different idea [200ms] of who you are.
l8b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">They all have a slightly different idea <break time="200ms"/> of who you are.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l8c.text: None of them is quite right.
l8c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">None of them is quite right.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l9a.text: You finally get what you've been working toward.
l9a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You finally get what you've been working toward.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l9b.text: It's exactly what you asked for.
l9b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">It's exactly what you asked for.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l9c.text: You can't remember why you wanted it.
l9c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You can't remember why you wanted it.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l10a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You can remember being happy.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l10b.text: You remember the places, [250ms] the people, [250ms] even what the weather was like.
l10b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You remember the places, <break time="250ms"/> the people, <break time="250ms"/> even what the weather was like.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l11a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Everyone is pleased with you.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l11c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You are considered a success.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l11d.text: You have no idea [200ms] what any of it is for.
l11d.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You have no idea <break time="200ms"/> what any of it is for.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

words.text: idea  what any of it is for.

l12a.text: You can leave whenever you like.
l12a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You can leave whenever you like.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l12b.text: No one is keeping you here.
l12b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">No one is keeping you here.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l12c.text: You just can't think of anywhere you would rather go.
l12c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You just can't think of anywhere you would rather go.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
l12c.edited: silences between words closed to 30 ms by hand after synthesis

l13a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">There is nothing wrong.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l13b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You have enough money.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l13c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Your health is good.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l13d.text: The people you love are doing well.
l13d.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">The people you love are doing well.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l13e.text: Every morning, [250ms] you wake up disappointed that it's morning.
l13e.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Every morning, <break time="250ms"/> you wake up disappointed that it's morning.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l14a.text: You begin to suspect [200ms] that something important is missing.
l14a.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You begin to suspect <break time="200ms"/> that something important is missing.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

words.text: suspect  that something important is missing.

l14b.text: You spend a very long time [200ms] trying to remember what it was.
l14b.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You spend a very long time <break time="200ms"/> trying to remember what it was.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

words.text: time  trying to remember what it was.

l14c.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">Eventually, <break time="300ms"/> you stop trying.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l15e.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">You go about your day.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>

l15f.text: And you no longer notice [300ms] that you're in [350ms] hell.
l15f.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-SerenaMultilingualNeural"><mstts:express-as style="serious">And you no longer notice <break time="300ms"/> that you're in <break time="350ms"/> hell.</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
